standard_prerequisites.use: The construction of the ideal sheaf of a closed immersion of algebraic spaces (Morphisms of Spaces, closed-immersion-ideals) and the definition of the higher conormal sheaf via that ideal; cited inputs with the restriction argument written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Choose a closed subspace T of X such that i becomes a closed immersion into X minus T.
Take the quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals I defining Z on X minus T.
Verify that I restricted to U minus the preimage of T is the ideal sheaf of the immersion Z_U into U minus the preimage of T.
Conclude the canonical functorial identification of the restricted higher conormal sheaf with that of Z_U over U.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the closed subspace and the defining ideal sheaf.
Check the restriction of the ideal computes the induced immersion and conclude the identification.

difficulty_reason: For an immersion Z -> X of algebraic spaces and an etale morphism U -> X with U a scheme, the lemma identifies the higher conormal sheaf C_{Z/X,*} restricted to Z_U with the higher conormal sheaf C_{Z_U/U}, canonically and functorially in U. The proof is a written reduction: choose a closed subspace T whose complement carries the immersion, take the defining quasi-coherent ideal I on X minus T, and observe that the restriction of I to U minus the preimage of T is the ideal sheaf of the induced immersion, which is clear from the construction of the ideal in the closed-immersion lemma. Retained author proof at lines 691-701.
